verdict.rationale: Brex documents in-product AI that produces suggestions and insights from the customer's own data. Brex AI suggests the matching PO and drafts payments. An audit agent flags potential expense violations and categorizes them by risk level. A review agent escalates exceptions, and AI assistants write memos and offer policy help. Missing for 10: broader analytical insights (e.g., spend trends, forecasting, savings recommendations), in-depth feature documentation beyond marketing pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.
